newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept crude steel output down 0.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept crude steel output down 0.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's crude steel production was 8.08 million tonnes in September, down 0.4 percent from a year earlier, marking the 14th successive month of year-on-year declines, the Japan Iron and Steel Federation said on Tuesday.
The September figure was, however, up 0.9 percent from August, the federation said in a statement.

Japan's crude steel production in the July-September period was 24.20 million tonnes, down 2.7 percent from the year-ago period, marking the fourth successive quarter of year-on-year declines, it said. July-September output was down 2.6 percent from the April-June quarter, it said.
On a half-year basis, Japan's crude steel output was down 4.4 percent from the same period a year ago to 49.06 million tonnes, the federation said.

September output of tin plate was 129,900 tonnes, down 2.6 percent year on year, and down 4.2 percent month on month, it said. Production of galvanised steel sheet in September was 915,300 tonnes, down 4.2 percent year on year, but up 4.0 percent month on month, the federation said.
